The Chinese characters for Carlos

As a transliteration, Carlos is usually written 卡洛斯 (Kǎ luò sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

洛

斯

Origin and meaning

The name Carlos has Spanish roots and means “free man (form of Charles)”.

About the name Carlos

The Spanish and Portuguese form of Charles, common throughout the Spanish-speaking world.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “free man (form of Charles)”, a Carlos calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
